rules.sentence: Prominent features in the histopathological examination of arsenical keratosis include compact hyperkeratosis, parakeratosis, and acanthosis.
Although biopsy does not confirm the diagnosis of arsenical keratosis, it is useful in detecting malignant transformation.
A similar histopathological picture can be observed in actinic keratosis, Bowen's disease, and verruca vulgaris; therefore, exposure history is essential in diagnosing arsenical keratosis.
